# cpanel_domain_alias (Data Source)

Looks up a cPanel alias of the account main domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cpanel_domain_alias" "site" {
  domain = "www.example.net"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) The alias domain name.

### Read-Only

- `document_root` (String) The shared main-domain document root relative to the cPanel account home.
- `target_domain` (String) The cPanel account main domain targeted by the alias.
